evidence.support_text: A 30-year-old male was patch tested with Denatonium Benzoate in an open patch test. He tested positive with petechia, wheals, and flare at concentrations of 2 × 10⁻², 2 × 10⁻³, and 2 × 10⁻⁴ mg/L; petechia and erythema at 2 × 10⁻⁵ mg/L; and erythema at 2 × 10⁻⁶ mg/L.
